name: Summer Playground Program
description_short: A town-run summer playground program at Lincoln's 5 major parks for children in grades 2-8, from 9 am to 4 pm. Children may come and go from the parks as they like, so this is not a drop-off camp where staff keep children on site.

warnings: This is a town Parks & Recreation page that lists many youth programs, such as basketball leagues, chess, lacrosse, tennis, STEM/LEGO, theater and app invention. Only the Summer Playground Program is recorded here as the camp.
No season year appears anywhere on the page. The text seems to be a standing description that is not updated each year, so the July 1st start date is not confirmed for 2027.
Children are 'free to enter and leave the parks at their own volition'. Staff do not hold children on site the way most day camps do.

The registration instructions conflict. The page says all registrations go through RecDesk, but the playground program describes in-person sign-up: 'Early Registration on last weekday of June at your local park... or sign up any open camp day at your local park.'
The phone number belongs to the Parks and Recreation Director and is not a number specific to this program.
unknowns: Season year and full dates for summer 2027 (page says only 'first day of camp is July 1st' with no year)
